scripts.dev: concurrently -c "cyan,magenta" -n client,server "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm run install:server
scripts.install:server: python3.12 -m venv server/.venv && server/.venv/bin/pip install -r server/requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
